'''Assault frigates''' were a class of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] utilized by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], and later the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The vessels were highly modified [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruisers]] that had been modified by a splinter group of [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]] designers. The superstructure was stripped back, allowing for the engine capacity to be increased which also lowered [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] consumption. The main modification was reducing the ship's crew requirements by adding automation in the form of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and [[Computer/Legends|computers]].<ref name="CSWE" />

The Rendili designers created a variety of assault frigates, incorporating [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]-designed [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generators]] for increased shield output. At least two distinct models were built; the [[Assault Frigate Mark I|Mark I]] and [[Assault Frigate Mark II/Legends|Mark II]] designs.<ref name="CSWE" />
